subject: [PATCH v3 3/6] btrfs: split btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index() into prealloc and commit phases

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch splits the btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index() function into three separate functions: prealloc, commit, and free. The prealloc function allocates resources that can fail with -ENOMEM, while the commit function performs the actual insertion and cannot fail with -ENOMEM. This allows callers to return -ENOMEM cleanly without aborting the transaction. The original btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index() is refactored into a thin wrapper that calls these new functions.
